name: security-review
description: Local SAST checks on edits plus a focused security review skill for high-risk changes.

documentation.overview: Adds a post-edit local SAST hook, exposes the builtin security_scan tool, and ships a reusable review skill.
documentation.whenToUse: Enable for sandbox, permission, shell, secrets, or trust-boundary work where every edit should be re-scanned locally.
documentation.lifecycle: The plugin stays inactive until explicitly enabled. Once enabled, hooks reload at runtime and fire after write/edit/notebook_edit tool use.
contributionNotes: Contributes builtin:security_scan through the manifest rather than custom code.
Ships a focused security-review skill under plugins/security-review/skills/.
examples: Use the security-review skill after changing permissions, sandboxing, or shell execution paths.
